name: Hybrid: local + pay-as-you-go API
license: Open WebUI License (interface); API billed by usage
summary: Use a free local model for everyday stuff, and plug in a top-tier model by API key for the hard tasks. You only pay for what you actually use.
gains: Access to frontier-quality models when you need them
Most light/medium users spend less than a $20 subscription
One interface for local and cloud models
tradeoffs: Heavy users can end up paying more than a flat subscription
You manage an API key and a spending limit
The $8/mo figure is a rough estimate for medium use
setupSteps: Set up Ollama + Open WebUI (see that guide)
Create an API account with a model provider and set a monthly spending limit
In Open WebUI go to Settings → Connections and paste your API key
Use the local model by default; switch to the API model for hard questions
commercialNote: Open WebUI's license asks you to keep its branding. Your API provider's terms also apply to what you send and generate.
